summary: Validated the new spoken_summary field on /api/doogie/sync-search and the /api/doogie/tts endpoint plus the frontend Play Summary button in DashboardMockup SyncedResults. All 4 new backend pytest cases passed (spoken_summary shape/compliance/no-opinion/Kelowna/active_count, empty body → empty summary, seller intent contains 'seller resources', TTS returns audio/mpeg > 10KB with X-EZ-TTS-Cache MISS then HIT). Frontend E2E: Play Summary button absent before search, present with text '▶ PLAY SUMMARY' after applying Kelowna filter, clicking flips to '■ STOP' and renders sync-summary-caption with the exact compliance-safe summary ('I found 2,092 active listings in Kelowna right now. Median list price is $799,900... Everything shown is informational only — not advice.'). Mic button (floating-filters-voice) present. Compliance banner + all 7 sync-section-* keys (marketinsights, intentinsights, communityprofile, glossary, faqs, communities, relatedsearches) still render. 0 JS console errors.

issues: Console warnings about preloaded Google fonts (Inter/Playfair) not used within window load — cosmetic only; existed before this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: spoken_summary compliance guard is well implemented — verified no opinion words (hot/great/deal/opportunity/good time/buyer's market/seller's market) appear even when MarketInsights market_type_label is 'Buyer's market conditions' (the summary correctly excludes the label wording).
TTS cache header (X-EZ-TTS-Cache) works as advertised (MISS → HIT on repeat). Rate limit 30/min not hit by tests.
Play button UX solid: idle='▶ PLAY SUMMARY', playing='■ STOP', caption renders live. Absent on initial load (correct).
Reminder from iter 12 still stands: server.py is ~13k lines; consider splitting sync/tts helpers into doogie_sync.py + doogie_tts.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New response field: sync-search returns 'spoken_summary' (string, possibly empty). Compliance tail is EXACTLY 'Everything shown is informational only — not advice.' (em dash). Seller intent triggers 'seller resources' phrase. TTS endpoint POST /api/doogie/tts accepts {text} and returns audio/mpeg + X-EZ-TTS-Cache header. Frontend Play button testid='sync-play-summary' toggles between '▶ PLAY SUMMARY' and '■ STOP'; caption testid='sync-summary-caption'. Auto-play is bound to voiceTriggerNonce bumped by the mic (not tested — real audio required).
